QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_47

question.text: Under Section 5.6.2, the SAS Framework does NOT cover:

answer.text: Social impact assessment of project/program of SEs
CSR Impact Assessment under Companies (CSR Policy) Amendment Rules, 2021
Financial audit, statutory audit, internal audit, or tax audit of an organisation
Engagement restricted to reporting entity as the sole intended user

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Section 5.6.2(d) and (e) state: 'This framework does not cover any elements of a financial audit or review, which may be covered by relevant financial auditing/review standards. Any other engagement(s) conducted by other assessors/auditors of an organisation e.g., statutory audit, internal audit, tax audit will not be covered under the scope of this framework.' **The Trap:** A and B are explicitly within scope (Section 5.6.2a, 5.6.2b). D is a permitted application (Section 5.6.2c — restrict report use). Only C is out of scope. **Cross-Exam Context:** NISM III-A / III-C tests audit-scope delineation; XXIII carves SIA cleanly from financial/statutory/tax audit. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** If an SE asks you to 'also do the statutory audit' while you're doing their SIA, you must formally refuse — combined-mandate prohibition is absolute under Section 5.6.2 scope carve-out.
